description: Hand the payment transaction to the server, right after sending it. The server reads the transaction on-chain and measures what reached the receiver in the invoice token; the payer must be the signer and the transaction must be newer than the invoice. The payer is screened again here (payer_blocked: a sanctioned or issuer-frozen payer does not count as paid). Pending until mined; invoice_get re-checks. An invoice holds at most 5 pending and 30 unconfirmed payments; past that, too_many_pending (429) until the network confirms the transaction, and a confirmed one is always accepted, so call again once it is mined. A hash pays each receiver once (tx_already_used once it confirmed another invoice of the same receiver and token); different receivers in one transaction are a batch payout.

payer.description: The wallet that signed the payment.

txHash.description: EVM transaction hash, or the Solana signature.

name: invoice_report_payment
